name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 6 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 53 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.5 days starting 2026-01-05, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.64 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
